topics.label: Introduction to Inflammation Initiation and Resolution
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture topic, reviews previous concepts, and outlines the focus on inflammatory mechanisms.

topics.label: Pathogen Recognition and PRR Signaling
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how the innate immune system senses pathogens and tissue damage through molecular patterns and pattern recognition receptor pathways.

topics.label: Cellular Inflammatory Responses and Systemic Consequences
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how sentinel cells coordinate the cellular and vascular events of inflammation, spanning local leukocyte recruitment, lymphatic drainage, and systemic complications.

topics.label: Resolution of Inflammation, Tissue Repair, and Chronic Responses
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the mechanisms by which acute inflammation ceases, tissue integrity is restored, and persistent or chronic inflammatory states develop.

topics.label: Conclusion and Next Lecture
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the presentation and announces the topic of the next lecture.
